title: Generative modeling with sparse transformers
body: We’ve developed the Sparse Transformer, a deep neural network which sets new records at predicting what comes next in a sequence—whether text, images, or sound. It uses an algorithmic improvement of the attention mechanism to extract patterns from sequences 30x longer than possible previously.
summaryZh: 本文来自OpenAI，围绕“Generative modeling with sparse transformers”介绍行业落地方面的最新进展，重点涉及行业应用。下方为系统保存的原文正文。
